research_question: Can P2 geometry deterministically express Table Structure?

p2_level1_facts.design_principle: Pure geometric facts, not interpretations. NO semantic classification.

G4_LocalGridCandidate.semantic_leakage: PARTIAL — true for prose (3/4) and figure (1/2)

G5_LocalRowCandidate.semantic_leakage: PARTIAL — true for ALL same-y pairs (table, prose, figure)

G6_LocalColumnCandidate.distinguishes_table_from_prose: N/A (requires vertical pair, not same-y scope)

TableMembership.reason: NOT EXPRESSIBLE FROM P2 ALONE — P2 geometry identical for table/prose/figure

case1_figure_caption.finding: P2 geometry for Figure Caption is IDENTICAL to Table. G1, G4, G5 cannot distinguish.

case2_prose.finding: P2 geometry for Prose is IDENTICAL to Table. G1, G4, G5 cannot distinguish.

case3_multicolumn.finding: Multi-column prose produces IDENTICAL P2 geometry to table. P2 has no independent table membership evidence.

counterexample_tests.conclusion: G1, G4, G5 are TRUE for ALL 545 pairs (Table=539, Prose=4, Figure=2). P2 cannot distinguish Table from non-Table.

p2_vs_tld_comparison.overlap: TLD uses P2 alignment/same_y_band for row/column, but adds heuristics

critical_question_answer.question: Is TLD creating new Structural Evidence, or organizing P2 Geometry?

detail.table_membership: CREATES new structural fact (not in P2)
detail.cell_assignment: CREATES new structural fact (not in P2)

critical_question_answer.conclusion: TLD is primarily a STRUCTURAL INTERPRETATION / DETECTION layer. P2 is a STRUCTURAL EVIDENCE SOURCE.

minimum_safe_structural_fact.limitation: Does NOT distinguish table from prose/figure

final_questions.q1_p2_direct_facts: bbox, width, height, center, alignment, distance, overlap, bands, direction, alignment groups, spatial clusters
final_questions.q2_level2_relations: G1-G6 (SameBandSeparatedPair, XAligned, YAligned, LocalGridCandidate, LocalRowCandidate, LocalColumnCandidate)
final_questions.q3_level3_interpretations: NONE — no table/row/column/cell/header/body expressible from P2
final_questions.q4_semantic_leakage: G4 and G5 — true for table, prose, AND figure
final_questions.q5_row_structure: PARTIAL — row candidate yes, table row no
final_questions.q6_column_structure: PARTIAL — column candidate yes (vertical), table column no. Page-wide groups are heterogeneous.
final_questions.q8_table_membership: NO — NOT EXPRESSIBLE FROM P2 ALONE
final_questions.q10_tld_adds: Table membership, cell assignment, table boundaries — 3 critical facts not in P2
final_questions.q11_m_b_dependency: HYBRID — uses P2 for diagnosis, consumer uses TLD
final_questions.q12_ph02_relation: P2 granularity sufficient, locality insufficient (page-wide groups)
final_questions.q13_minimum_safe: G1 SameBandSeparatedPair (pure geometry, no leakage, but not table-specific)
final_questions.q14_new_observation: NO — P2 provides all geometry, TLD provides interpretation

retrospective_vs_generalizable.reason: No independent corpus validation. 545 pairs are from one sampling frame.

primary_bottleneck: D (Consumer Integration) — P2 evidence exists, IS-11 does not use it. But P2 alone CANNOT replace TLD (no table membership).
recommended_next_step: READ-ONLY audit of TLD visual line heuristics — understand what TLD adds beyond P2
